title: 生物安全的五个 P
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/11_5P's of biosafety biosafety microbiology raqbamicrohub laboratory.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/11_5P's of biosafety biosafety microbiology raqbamicrohub laboratory/src.py

points.K3: P2 人员：能力、培训与健康
points.K7: 五个 P 一起看，定风险

shots.scene: 欣欣站在微生物实验室里，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a microbiology lab and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲生物安全的五个 P。

shots.scene: 欣欣伸出五根手指，身旁浮现五个空白图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up five fingers, with five blank icons floating beside it.
shots.narration: 五个 P，是风险评估的要点。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一张新实验任务单，有点发愁
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a blank task sheet, looking worried.
shots.narration: 阿杰接到一个新实验。

shots.scene: 小研走过来，欣欣也出现
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over; the panda mascot appears too.
shots.narration: 小研说：先按五个 P 评一评。

shots.scene: 放大镜照着一张空白风险评估表
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over a blank risk assessment form. No people.
shots.narration: 做风险评估，要看五个核心要素。
overlay: 生物安全的 5 个 P

shots.scene: 五个并排的空白槽位，标 P1 到 P5
shots.prompt_en: Five blank slots in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 病原、人员、场所、防护、规程。

shots.scene: 五个槽位依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The five slots light up one after another. No people.
shots.narration: 它们的英文都以 P 开头。

shots.scene: 一个微生物图标配一只放大镜
shots.prompt_en: A microbe icon with a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: P1 病原：先搞清对手是谁。

shots.scene: 高低不等的危害条块
shots.prompt_en: Hazard bars of different heights next to a microbe icon. No people.
shots.narration: 用的是什么病原，危害有多大。

shots.section_title: P2 人员：能力、培训与健康
shots.scene: 几个人形图标旁边有体检和培训图标
shots.prompt_en: Several figure icons beside a health-check icon and a training icon. No people shown in detail.
shots.narration: P2 人员：谁来做，能力和健康。

shots.section_title: P2 人员：能力、培训与健康
shots.scene: 一张合格的准入胸牌图标
shots.prompt_en: An approved access-badge icon. No people.
shots.narration: 能力够不够，培训到不到位。

shots.section_title: P2 人员：能力、培训与健康
shots.scene: 体检图标上打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A health-check icon with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 身体状况，也要考虑进去。

shots.scene: 一栋实验楼配一个级别标牌
shots.prompt_en: A lab building icon next to a level sign. No people.
shots.narration: P3 场所：实验室够不够级别。

shots.scene: 门口一块生物安全级别标牌
shots.prompt_en: A biosafety-level door sign at a lab entrance. No people.
shots.narration: 级别要配得上病原危害。

shots.scene: 手套、白大褂、口罩、护目镜四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: gloves, lab coat, mask, goggles. No people.
shots.narration: P4 个人防护：穿戴对装备。

shots.scene: 小研穿戴好全套防护
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears a full set of PPE.
shots.narration: 按需要选用防护用品，

shots.scene: 小研对着镜子检查手套和口罩是否戴好
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks in a mirror that her gloves and mask are worn correctly.
shots.narration: 并且正确穿戴。

shots.scene: 一份空白操作规程文件图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank standard-operating-procedure document icon. No people.
shots.narration: P5 操作规程：按步骤来做。

shots.scene: 一张带勾选框的步骤清单
shots.prompt_en: A checklist with step boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 规程写清楚，照着做。

shots.section_title: 五个 P 一起看，定风险
shots.scene: 五个齿轮相互咬合转动
shots.prompt_en: Five gears meshing together. No people.
shots.narration: 五个 P 相互影响。

shots.section_title: 五个 P 一起看，定风险
shots.scene: 一架天平把五个因素合起来称
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale weighing five combined factors. No people.
shots.narration: 一起看，才定得准风险。

shots.section_title: 五个 P 一起看，定风险
shots.scene: 欣欣指向一排控制措施图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a row of control-measure icons.
shots.narration: 再定该用哪些控制措施。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁排开五个 P 的图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside five lined-up icons. No text on them.
shots.narration: 五个 P：病原、人员、场所、防护、规程。

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起一根手指提醒
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises one finger as a reminder.
shots.narration: 五者一起，决定风险和控制措施。

shots.scene: 欣欣在实验室门口向镜头挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the lab door.
shots.narration: 记牢五个 P，下次见！
